headline: IMF Notes Rogun Hydropower Plant Will Boost Tajikistan Energy Exports
summary: The International Monetary Fund reported that the Rogun hydroelectric dam project will significantly reduce winter electricity shortages in Tajikistan, reduce tariffs, and expand the nation's clean power export capacity across Central Asia.
why: Upon completion, the Rogun hydropower plant will feature the world's tallest embankment dam, converting Tajikistan into a primary regional electricity exporter.

impacts.name: Tajikistan
impacts.why: Expanding hydroelectric capacity reduces power shortages and generates cross-border electricity export income.
